# pi-web-search

> Pi tools for best-effort public web (keyless Exa and native Parallel MCP fallback) and public code (grep.app, Sourcegraph, optional GitHub). Research and external Jev judgment are separate opt-ins, off by default.

This file is a navigation index for agents, not an API specification. Paths are relative to this package. For the monorepo, see [root llms.txt](../llms.txt).

## Documentation

- [Package README](README.md): install, tools, defaults, optional setup, config, and code-search notes.
- [Multi-source search and Jev](docs/research.md): judgment settings, Pi classifier selection, and fail-open behavior.
- [Classifier support plan](docs/classifier-plan.md): planned local/custom selection.

## Source contracts

- [Tool registration](src/index.ts): tools, first-run welcome, and `/web-search-settings`.
- [Configuration resolver](src/providers/config.ts): accepted settings and defaults.
- [Provider orchestration](src/providers/index.ts): ordinary chains versus research fan-out.
- [Sourcegraph](src/providers/sourcegraph.ts): keyless stream search.
- [GitHub](src/providers/github.ts): authenticated REST; token or `gh auth`.
- [Jev classifier](src/jev/api.ts): Pi model registry typed classification.
- [Structured output](src/format.ts): fields, previews, truncation, and errors.
